decisions.reason: The supplied URL is specifically for the dealer login button and does not change the early-access CTA destination.
The login destination does not alter the hero visualization, its depicted controls, gallery, or device presentation.
The dealer login URL does not affect contact-form submission delivery or recipient emails.
The source identifies the separate dealer login destination and does not change the contact page's available actions.
Assigning a URL to the dealer login button does not change the landing page's content types, image quantity, or screenshot policy.
The login URL does not modify the landing page's visual aesthetic, brand assets, or style reference.
The dealer login destination is unrelated to the founder image and its placement at the bottom of the landing page.
The source supplies a login URL but does not change the hero headline or body copy.
The dealer login URL does not change the Webflow website artifact or its handoff destination.
The login destination does not alter the Founding Dealer contact-page headline or body copy.
The dealer login URL does not change the contact form's required fields or comment-box requirement.
The application login destination does not change the requirement to select the cheapest suitable Webflow site plan.
